product_metadata.title: Bormioli Rocco Romantic Set Of 4 Tumbler Glasses, 11.5 Oz. Colored Crystal Glass, Light Blue, Made In Italy.
features: THE PERFECT GLASSES FOR FORMAL DINNERS Our unique glasses feature a Victorian-inspired design with a vintage feel that’s perfect for casual entertaining or more formal dinner parties. Their ROMANTIC feel make them excellent for a night with a special person or your family and Friends.

ITALIAN MADE QUALITY GLASS Invest in a premium set of tumbler glasses that can take any use and abuse. They are resistant to breakage and chipping, plus, they feature an embossed pattern that gives them a unique, artisanal look.

GREAT FOR ALL BEVERAGES Choose a versatile set of drinking glasses that can hold virtually everything, juice, water, coke, soda, lemonade or even wine or spirits. Their spacious size is perfect to cater to the tastes of every single guest!

CRYSTAL CLEAR QUALITY EVEN AFTER MANY WASHES Our quality glassware set is dishwasher safe which means you can simply throw it in the machine and rest assured that they will always look as crystal clear as they did the first day you got them!

IMPRESS YOUR GUESTS ON ANY OCCASION These high-quality glasses can easily be used on casual family gatherings and dinner parties but they are specifically meant for formal dinners and special gatherings where you need to make an impression and take good care of your guests or a special someone.
description: The Romantic collection of Highball Glasses from Bormioli Rocco marries the Italian brand's longstanding dedication to producing high-quality drinking glasses with a unique design that is sure to capture the hearts of those seeking something a little different from the ordinary. Taking inspiration from the enchanting warmth and color of a summer garden, each glass in this collection has been etched with a delicate floral motif that is certain to catch the eye as it sparkles in the sun. The glass itself has been crafted to the same exemplary standards as all Bormioli Rocco products, with crystal clarity and a strength that will let these glasses be a part of your kitchen cabinet for years to come. These Highball Glasses boast a 11.5 Oz capacity - perfect for presenting a range of vibrant long drinks and cocktails, as well as beers, soft drinks, juices and more. Combine with the matching Water Jug and Wine Glasses to transform your home or garden into the perfect piece of Bohemian paradise!
